conventions.cell_shape: Every assessed cell is {value, status, evidence}. NO BARE VALUES. A cell with status != MEASURED must never be cited as fact.

status_enum.MEASURED: read from the live artifact/API/source at a stated time; evidence names the call or file:line
status_enum.INFERRED: derived from measured facts but not directly observed; NON-ACTIONABLE per CLAUDE.md Rule 22
status_enum.UNMEASURED: not yet read; evidence names the exact call that would fill it
status_enum.NOT_MEASURABLE: no instrument can answer it from this artifact; evidence says why
